title: item.update
description: Update existing items. Web items cannot be updated via the Zabbix API.

itemid.description: ID of the item to update.

delay.description: Update interval of the item. Accepts seconds or a time unit with suffix (30s,1m,2h,1d). Optionally one or more custom intervals can be specified either as flexible intervals or scheduling. Multiple intervals are separated by a semicolon. User macros may be used. A single macro has to fill the whole field. Multiple macros in a field or macros mixed with text are not supported. Flexible intervals may be written as two macros separated by a forward slash (e.g. {$FLEX_INTERVAL}/{$FLEX_PERIOD}). Optional for Zabbix trapper, dependent items and for Zabbix agent (active) with mqtt.get key.

interfaceid.description: ID of the item's host interface. Used only for host items. Not required for Zabbix agent (active), Zabbix internal, Zabbix trapper, calculated, dependent, database monitor and script items. Optional for HTTP agent items.

type.description: Type of the item. Possible values: 0 - Zabbix agent; 2 - Zabbix trapper; 3 - Simple check; 5 - Zabbix internal; 7 - Zabbix agent (active); 9 - Web item; 10 - External check; 11 - Database monitor; 12 - IPMI agent; 13 - SSH agent; 14 - Telnet agent; 15 - Calculated; 16 - JMX agent; 17 - SNMP trap; 18 - Dependent item; 19 - HTTP agent; 20 - SNMP agent; 21 - Script.

url.description: URL string, required only for HTTP agent item type. Supports user macros, {HOST.IP}, {HOST.CONN}, {HOST.DNS}, {HOST.HOST}, {HOST.NAME}, {ITEM.ID}, {ITEM.KEY}.

value_type.description: Type of information of the item. Possible values: 0 - numeric float; 1 - character; 2 - log; 3 - numeric unsigned; 4 - text.

allow_traps.description: HTTP agent item field. Allow to populate value as in trapper item type also. 0 - (default) Do not allow to accept incoming data. 1 - Allow to accept incoming data.

authtype.description: Used only by SSH agent items or HTTP agent items. SSH agent authentication method possible values: 0 - (default) password; 1 - public key. HTTP agent authentication method possible values: 0 - (default) none; 1 - basic; 2 - NTLM; 3 - Kerberos.

follow_redirects.description: HTTP agent item field. Follow response redirects while polling data. 0 - Do not follow redirects. 1 - (default) Follow redirects.

headers.description: HTTP agent item field. Object with HTTP(S) request headers, where header name is used as key and header value as value. Example: { "User-Agent": "Zabbix" }

history.description: A time unit of how long the history data should be stored. Also accepts user macro. Default: 90d.

http_proxy.description: HTTP agent item field. HTTP(S) proxy connection string.

inventory_link.description: ID of the host inventory field that is populated by the item. Default: 0.

ipmi_sensor.description: IPMI sensor. Used only by IPMI items.

jmx_endpoint.description: JMX agent custom connection string. Default value: service:jmx:rmi:///jndi/rmi://{HOST.CONN}:{HOST.PORT}/jmxrmi

logtimefmt.description: Format of the time in log entries. Used only by log items.

master_itemid.description: Master item ID. Recursion up to 3 dependent items and maximum count of dependent items equal to 29999 are allowed. Required by dependent items.

output_format.description: HTTP agent item field. Should response be converted to JSON. 0 - (default) Store raw. 1 - Convert to JSON.

params.description: Additional parameters depending on the type of the item: executed script for SSH and Telnet items; SQL query for database monitor items; formula for calculated items; the script for script item.

parameters.description: Additional parameters for script items. Array of objects with 'name' and 'value' properties, where name must be unique.

password.description: Password for authentication. Used by simple check, SSH, Telnet, database monitor, JMX and HTTP agent items. When used by JMX, username should also be specified together with password or both properties should be left blank.

post_type.description: HTTP agent item field. Type of post data body stored in posts property. 0 - (default) Raw data. 2 - JSON data. 3 - XML data.

posts.description: HTTP agent item field. HTTP(S) request body data. Used with post_type.

privatekey.description: Name of the private key file.

publickey.description: Name of the public key file.

query_fields.description: HTTP agent item field. Query parameters. Array of objects with 'key':'value' pairs, where value can be empty string.

request_method.description: HTTP agent item field. Type of request method. 0 - (default) GET. 1 - POST. 2 - PUT. 3 - HEAD.

retrieve_mode.description: HTTP agent item field. What part of response should be stored. 0 - (default) Body. 1 - Headers. 2 - Both body and headers will be stored. For request_method HEAD only 1 is allowed value.

ssl_cert_file.description: HTTP agent item field. Public SSL Key file path.

ssl_key_file.description: HTTP agent item field. Private SSL Key file path.

ssl_key_password.description: HTTP agent item field. Password for SSL Key file.

status.description: Status of the item. Possible values: 0 - (default) enabled item; 1 - disabled item.

status_codes.description: HTTP agent item field. Ranges of required HTTP status codes separated by commas. Also supports user macros as part of comma separated list. Example: 200,200-{$M},{$M},200-400

timeout.description: Item data polling request timeout. Used for HTTP agent and script items. Supports user macros. default: 3s maximum value: 60s

trapper_hosts.description: Allowed hosts. Used by trapper items or HTTP agent items.

trends.description: A time unit of how long the trends data should be stored. Also accepts user macro. Default: 365d.

username.description: Username for authentication. Used by simple check, SSH, Telnet, database monitor, JMX and HTTP agent items. Required by SSH and Telnet items. When used by JMX, password should also be specified together with username or both properties should be left blank.

uuid.description: Universal unique identifier, used for linking imported item to already existing ones. Used only for items on templates. Auto-generated, if not given.

valuemapid.description: ID of the associated value map.

verify_host.description: HTTP agent item field. Whether to validate that the host name for the connection matches the one in the host's certificate. 0 - (default) Do not validate. 1 - Validate.

verify_peer.description: HTTP agent item field. Whether to validate that the host's certificate is authentic. 0 - (default) Do not validate. 1 - Validate.

preprocessing.description: Item preprocessing options to replace the current preprocessing options.

type.description: The preprocessing option type. Possible values: 1 - Custom multiplier; 2 - Right trim; 3 - Left trim; 4 - Trim; 5 - Regular expression matching; 6 - Boolean to decimal; 7 - Octal to decimal; 8 - Hexadecimal to decimal; 9 - Simple change; 10 - Change per second; 11 - XML XPath; 12 - JSONPath; 13 - In range; 14 - Matches regular expression; 15 - Does not match regular expression; 16 - Check for error in JSON; 17 - Check for error in XML; 18 - Check for error using regular expression; 19 - Discard unchanged; 20 - Discard unchanged with heartbeat; 21 - JavaScript; 22 - Prometheus pattern; 23 - Prometheus to JSON; 24 - CSV to JSON; 25 - Replace; 26 - Check unsupported; 27 - XML to JSON.

params.description: Additional parameters used by preprocessing option. Multiple parameters are separated by LF (\n) character.

error_handler.description: Action type used in case of preprocessing step failure. Possible values: 0 - Error message is set by Zabbix server; 1 - Discard value; 2 - Set custom value; 3 - Set custom error message.

error_handler_params.description: Error handler parameters. Used with error_handler. Must be empty, if error_handler is 0 or 1. Can be empty if, error_handler is 2. Cannot be empty, if error_handler is 3.
